About

Finance domain depth, engineered.

Adinath Kadam is a finance analytics and reporting-automation professional focused on SQL-based reporting workflows, FP&A data pipelines, Power BI / Tableau dashboard support, Excel Power Query automation, large-scale finance data analysis, and decision-support reporting systems.

The work sits where finance meets data engineering: replacing fragile, manual spreadsheet processes with governed, repeatable pipelines that move data from source systems through transformation to dashboard-ready outputs leadership can act on.

That combination — finance fluency plus the ability to build the systems that produce the numbers — is the through-line across the work below.
